acf.short_intro: Known for her calm, reassuring approach, {{doctor.name}} personally guides each couple through diagnosis, treatment and pregnancy. Her focus is simple: the right treatment, explained honestly, delivered gently.

page_photo.alt: {{doctor.name}}, Senior IVF and Infertility Specialist at {{hospitalName}}

acf.about:
{{doctor.name}} is a Senior IVF & Infertility Specialist at {{hospitalName}}, {{city}}. She leads the hospital’s fertility programme and personally plans treatment for couples who have been trying to conceive.

Patients describe her as positive and encouraging, a doctor who explains every report patiently and helps couples decide with confidence.

Her work focuses on personalised IVF and ICSI, PCOS, low ovarian reserve, male-factor infertility and couples who have had unsuccessful treatment elsewhere. She believes in recommending only what a couple truly needs, and in being honest about their chances.

expertise.text: Personalised IVF cycles planned around your reports.

expertise.text: Making the most of every cycle when time matters.

expertise.title: Male infertility
expertise.text: Diagnosis and treatment for male-factor issues.

expertise.title: Repeated IVF failure
expertise.text: Careful review and a fresh, personalised plan.

expertise.title: Unexplained infertility
expertise.text: When all tests are normal but pregnancy hasn't happened.

expertise.title: High-risk pregnancy care
expertise.text: Close care after IVF and for complex pregnancies.
